_comment: Which version of each multi-version construct the synthesis READS (arbiter, 2026-10-04: 'all versions + a governing-version map'). final:* carries every non-deprecated version that survives the formula; this map resolves which one answers a synthesis question. Non-governing versions remain reportable (e.g. for the v1→v2 reclassification delta).

rules-based-checks.ruling: §156 — static analysis / rule checks, tests excluded

deterministic-orchestration.ruling: §151/§158 — -v2 is the superset (removed OR withheld discretion); the original is the narrower 'discretion removed' subset
